name: Denver Dan's
description: In 4398 Bumble Bee Lane, CA, Denver Dan's raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
